description: Land Acquisition - Wegama, Bibila D/S Division, Monaragala District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for canal construction, including lot numbers, land names, claimants, possessors, and exact land extents. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions, property ownership details, and government land acquisition procedures.
